:::{#exm-deriv-lincom}
#### Derivative of a dot product

Let $\vx = \tp{(3, 5)}$ (constant with respect to $\vcoef$;
see @exm-constant-wrt-vector) and $\vcoef = \tp{(\coef{1}, \coef{2})}$.
Then $\vx \cdot \vcoef = 3\coef{1} + 5\coef{2}$, and by @thm-deriv-lincom:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\underbrace{\deriv{\vcoef}(\vx \cdot \vcoef)}_{2 \times 1}
&= \underbrace{\vx}_{2 \times 1} \\
&= \begin{pmatrix} 3 \\
5 \end{pmatrix}
\end{aligned}
$$

Verifying entry-wise:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\deriv{\vcoef}(3\coef{1} + 5\coef{2})
&= \begin{pmatrix} \deriv{\coef{1}}(3\coef{1} + 5\coef{2}) \\
\deriv{\coef{2}}(3\coef{1} + 5\coef{2}) \end{pmatrix} \\
&= \begin{pmatrix} 3 \\
5 \end{pmatrix}
\end{aligned}
$$

Both methods agree.

:::
